manifest.name: dsh-approval-timeout
manifest.description: Auto-rejects an unanswered approval prompt and auto-skips an unanswered question after a configurable timeout (default 10 minutes).
manifest.author: EviMing

readme.text:
授权提示 / 提问提示的超时自动处理（DeepSeek Harness Web UI 插件）。

English: [README.en.md](README.en.md)

Harness 在浏览器里等用户点击时会一直阻塞。本插件给这两种等待都加了截止时间，默认 **10 分钟**：

- **授权**（`approval`）：超时未点击即自动按「拒绝」处理，等价于你自己点了「拒绝」——
  写入同样的 `approval/decided: rejected` 审计事件，面板消失，工具调用以拒绝结束（fail closed）。
- **提问**（`ask_user_question`）：超时未回答即自动按「跳过」处理——等价于你把每道题都留空点
  「跳过」，agent 收到的是 `{ answers: [{ id, selected: [] }, ...] }`，也就是明确的「用户没作答」，
  不会被当成默许，也不会伪造一个回复；面板消失，工具返回空答案并继续。
  如果你正在作答（面板聚焦 / 输入框编辑中），截止时间会顺延 60 秒，不打断手里的答案。

没有等待时插件完全静默。选「关闭」即恢复 dsh 原生行为（无限等待）。

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:EviMing/dsh-approval-timeout

readme.section: 或用 npm 包（如有发布）：
readme.text:
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-approval-timeout
```

重启 / 刷新 `dsh web`。输入框（composer）下方会出现一行：

```
审批/提问超时   [10 分钟 ▾]
```

- 下拉框调时间：**关闭 / 1 / 3 / 5 / 10 / 15 / 30 / 60 分钟**，立即生效并记住。
- 有授权在等待时，这一行变成黄色并显示倒计时，例如 `bash: 9:58 后自动拒绝`。
- 有提问在等待时同样变黄，例如 `提问：9:58 后自动跳过`。
- 设置存在浏览器 `localStorage`（键 `dsh.approval-timeout.minutes`）：按浏览器 profile 持久化，
  没有服务端配置，也不改任何 profile 文件。

只处理「当前真的阻塞着 agent、且面板还活着」的请求，其余一律不碰：

- 已结算、只读的提问卡片（没有回答通道，回答它等于向 agent 注入不存在的回复）；
- 已经断开实时通道的旧卡片（`continued`）；
- 客户端自己已有倒计时的提问（`ask_user_question` 的 timed 模式）；
- 计划审批（`plan-review`）**故意不自动跳过**：它唯一非批准的结果是「继续规划」，agent 会改完
  再提一次，超时只会变成反复循环，所以这里宁可按原生无限等待；
- 没有 callId、又无法取消的卡片（只收起面板，不结束请求）。

授权面板由 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-approval`、提问面板由 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-user-questions`
在浏览器里渲染。HOST 侧的 `approval/request`、`user-questions/request` waterfall 只负责把请求转发给
浏览器并等待客户端作答；gateway 只在「客户端作答」或「请求 signal 中止」时收尾。如果插件在 HOST 侧
抢先 return，面板不会消失、工具却已经结束，用户之后再点按钮就变成空操作。

因此本插件直接读取 `ctx.uiSession.sessionStatus` 里当前会话的 `pendingInteraction`（即真实的
`PendingApproval` / `PendingQuestion` 实例），到点调用它自己的方法——`pending.answer('rejected')`
（授权）、`pending.answer({ answers: [...] })`（提问）、或 `pending.dismiss()`（无法回答、只能取消的
卡片）——和用户点按钮走完全同一条路径，审计、面板与工具结局因此保持一致。

- 永远只会「拒绝」或「跳过」，没有任何自动批准的代码路径。
- 无网络请求、不读凭据、不发会话事件、不写 `document.body`。
- 只有两类副作用：一次 `pending.answer(...)` 调用，以及 `localStorage` 里的一个整数。
- 卸载：`dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-approval-timeout`（或在插件页禁用）后刷新，不留残留。

```bash
node verify/offline.mjs
```

离线自测不需要浏览器：它用假的 `window.__ModuleLoader__`、React、Client services、假
`PendingApproval` 与假 `PendingQuestion` 驱动 `client.js`，覆盖默认 10 分钟、倒计时文案、
改时间后重排、到点审批 `answer('rejected')`、多选题一次发出跳过批、rpc/continued/timed/只读卡
/plan 卡不跟踪、编辑中顺延 60 秒、无 callId 卡只 `dismiss()`、以及选「关闭」时完全不动。

在 dsh `0.2.0-rc.2`（`dsh web`）上测试，依赖 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-session`、
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-approval`，提问部分与 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-user-questions` 协作
（按鸭子类型读取，不强制注入）。桌面版若捆绑了更旧的 dsh、缺少 `uiSession.sessionStatus`，
插件会保持静默而不是报错。
MIT

Answers an unanswered approval prompt or an unanswered question in the DeepSeek Harness (dsh) Web UI after a configurable timeout — **10 minutes by default**.

中文: [README.md](README.md)
Harness blocks in the browser until you click. This plugin puts a deadline on both waits:

- **Approvals**: at the deadline the prompt is answered with `rejected` exactly as if you clicked **Reject** — the panel goes away, the tool call fails as rejected, and the same `approval/decided: rejected` audit event is written. It only ever rejects, never approves, so a stale prompt fails closed.
- **Questions** (`ask_user_question`): at the deadline every question is answered with an empty selection, exactly as if you pressed **Skip** — the agent receives `{ answers: [{ id, selected: [] }, ...] }`, an explicit "the user did not answer", never a fabricated reply and never an implied approval. The panel goes away and the tool returns the empty batch.
- While you are answering (panel focused, text being edited) the deadline slips by 60 seconds instead of discarding what you typed.
With nothing pending the plugin is dormant. Picking **Off** restores dsh's native behavior (wait forever).

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:EviMing/dsh-approval-timeout

dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-approval-timeout
```

Restart / reload `dsh web`. A control appears under the composer:

```
Approval/question timeout   [10 min ▾]
```

- Pick the timeout from the menu: **Off / 1 / 3 / 5 / 10 / 15 / 30 / 60 minutes**. Takes effect immediately and is remembered.
- While an approval is pending the row turns yellow and shows a countdown, e.g. `bash: auto-reject in 9:58`.
- While a question is pending it shows `Question: auto-skip in 9:58`.
- The value lives in browser `localStorage` (`dsh.approval-timeout.minutes`) — per browser profile, no server-side config, no profile patch edits.
It only touches requests that are still blocking the agent and whose panel is alive:

readme.section: Why it lives in the client
readme.text: The approval panel is rendered in the browser by `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-approval`, the question panel by `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-user-questions`. The host-side `approval/request` and `user-questions/request` waterfalls only forward the request to the browser and wait for the client to answer; the gateway settles solely on a client answer or on an aborted request signal. A host-side answerer that returns early would leave the panel on screen while the tool was already settled, turning a later click into a no-op.

readme.section: Why it lives in the client
readme.text: So this plugin reads the session's `pendingInteraction` from `ctx.uiSession.sessionStatus` (the live `PendingApproval` / `PendingQuestion` instance) and calls its own methods at the deadline — `pending.answer('rejected')` for approvals, `pending.answer({ answers: [...] })` for questions, `pending.dismiss()` for cards that can only be cancelled — the exact path a click takes, so audit, panel, and tool outcome stay consistent.

- Reject-only and skip-only; there is no code path that approves on timeout.
- No network requests, no credential access, no session events, no `document.body` writes.
- Only side effects: one `pending.answer(...)` call and one integer in `localStorage`.
- Uninstall: `dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-approval-timeout` (or disable it in the plugins page), then reload. Nothing is left behind.

The offline harness needs no browser: it drives `client.js` with a fake `window.__ModuleLoader__`, React, client services, a fake `PendingApproval` and a fake `PendingQuestion` that record calls, then asserts the 10-minute default, the countdown text, the reschedule on change, the approval `answer('rejected')` at the deadline, one skip batch covering several questions, that rpc/continued/timed/read-only/plan cards are left alone, the 60-second slip while editing, dismissal of an unnamed card, and that **Off** leaves everything untouched.

Tested on dsh `0.2.0-rc.2` (`dsh web`) with `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-session` and
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-approval`; the question half talks to
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-user-questions` by duck typing, so it needs no extra injection.
A desktop build bundling an older dsh may lack `uiSession.sessionStatus`; the plugin then stays
inert rather than erroring.
MIT
